claims: Stoichiometry: 4 Fe2+ per CO2 fixed (Widdel et al. 1993; Canfield et al. 2006); 2 H2 per CO2 (Kharecha et al. 2005); chemolithotroph and methanogen yields are order-of-magnitude growth yields (McCollom and Amend 2005)

…s L1a's growth yields (about 0.1 C per H2 aerobically, 0.01 C per H2 for methanogens; McCollom and Amend 2005). Roden and Jin 2011 find yield rises in step with energy, which this assumes; their slope is to be read (fudge register)
